scripts.name: Quality Check - New Customer
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; Both -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: how'd they come out?
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
First run with us, so I want to be sure we nailed it. Did your [PROJECT NAME] turn out the way you pictured? If anything's not right, just reply and I'm on it.
And if it came out great, a quick Google review would mean a lot. We're a small, women-owned, family-run shop, and a few honest words from you help the next person find us. If you can mention your [PROJECT NAME] and add a photo, even better. It shows people exactly what we make.
Leave us a Google review: https://g.page/r/CQhn52SlLBoeEBM/review
One click. Takes about 20 seconds.
Thanks for choosing Planet Apparel.
[OWNER SIGNATURE]

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Intro
scripts.sentByRule: Kelly/Shara send from bandanas@ cc team@; Cortney sends her own share as ^xsellc from team@; Both-dept boxes -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: a thought on your [PROJECT NAME] run
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Your [PRODUCT] came out great. Quick thought while it's fresh: bandanas are how most people meet us, but if you can put a logo on it, we've probably made it. Shirts, hats, custom promo, all of it.

My teammate Cortney runs that side of the shop and she's copied here. If anything catches your eye or you've got something coming up, just reply and she'll take care of you.

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Response
scripts.sentByRule: Cortney sends when a customer bites on the intro, within 1 business day.
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Cortney here, I run the apparel and promo side at Planet Apparel. Shara passed your note over, happy to help.

What's it for, the crew, an event, client gifts? Tell me what you're picturing and I'll put real numbers together. We've already got your [PROJECT NAME] art on file, so setup is the easy part.

No commitment. If the numbers look right, we'll go from there.
scripts.firesWhen: When a customer replies to the Cross-Sell Intro. Reply in the intro thread, no new subject.
scripts.notes: v3 2026-07-09: custom promo + lookbook link added, mockup hook removed. Holly-approved verbatim — do not re-edit. CONDITIONAL: when the intro was Cortney's own ^xsellc, delete the line "Shara passed your note over, happy to help." — she is already on the thread.

scripts.sentByRule: Cortney sends ONE light touch ~1 week after a bite goes quiet, then stops.
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Just closing the loop on the apparel and promo idea. Your art is still on file, so whenever you're ready it's a quick start.

And if this isn't the season for it, that's an easy no. Tell me to sit tight and I will, no follow-up chain coming your way.

Glad we got to be part of the [PROJECT NAME] run either way.

scripts.notes: v3 2026-07-09: custom promo + lookbook link added, mockup hook removed. Holly-approved verbatim — do not re-edit.

scripts.name: At-Risk Touch 1
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; Both -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: you crossed my mind
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
It's been a couple months since our last project together, so I wanted to see how you're doing and make sure there's nothing coming down the pipeline I can help you get ahead of.
Also, I'm not sure you've ever seen the full range of what we make. Here's our lookbook if you want a peek: https://planetholly.github.io/lookbook-2026/
If you can put a logo on it, we've probably made it.
Nothing needed on your end. You know where to find me.
scripts.firesWhen: At entry into AT RISK. T1 = call (atrisk1-call); T2 = this email within two weeks; T3 = skip. Feeds Mail Merge auto-follow-up to Touch 2.
scripts.notes: Shelby angle: pattern-interrupt subject, one probing question, anti-sell, one ask.

scripts.name: At-Risk Touch 2
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner sends; Both -> Cortney (auto-flip w/ manual override); named bandana whales stay Shara.
scripts.subject: should I stop bugging you?
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
My last email might've gotten buried, so I'm floating it back up. No rush at all.
If there's something coming up I can help you get ahead of, I'm around. And if it's just a quiet season on your end, that's totally fine too.
scripts.firesWhen: Midpoint of the AT RISK window; fires only if Touch 1 got no reply. A different shape, not a repeat.
scripts.notes: Genericized (no typed blank) so it runs as a Mail Merge auto-follow-up.

scripts.name: T1 Quality Check Call
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner calls (T1 only). Folds the cross-sell intro into the same call.
scripts.bodyText:
OPENER: "Hi [FIRST NAME], it's [PM] at Planet Apparel. Your [PROJECT NAME] should've landed. Did it come out the way you pictured?"
React like a person, name a real detail if you saw the order.
NOTE: they also received our QC email with the review button. If they mention it, great - do NOT push the review on the phone.
IF VOICEMAIL: totally fine, the email already carries the QC ask and the review button. One voicemail, no chase.
scripts.firesWhen: Week 1 for T1 New Customers - the personal call that replaces the QC email and folds in the cross-sell intro.
scripts.notes: v2 2026-07-09: the call now SUPPLEMENTS the auto QC/review email (Round 9 P2) - it never replaces it. Email always sends to every tier; this call adds the personal layer for T1.

scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],
Your [PROJECT NAME] project from last [MONTH OF LAST ORDER] is coming up on a year, and I wanted to get ahead of your next one so it's handled before you need it.
I've still got everything from that run on file, so if something's on the horizon I can have it lined up with priority turnaround. And if you're planning anything past bandanas, we do apparel and branded merch too, so I can get ahead of that for you the same way.

scripts.bodyText:

IF VOICEMAIL: warm 15-second version of the same, no callback pressure.

touchpoints.name: Web Intake
touchpoints.notes: Creates the Sale box, stamps Intake=Form, sets first Relationship Status.

touchpoints.name: Pass 1 - PM-Box Enrich
touchpoints.notes: Stamps Intake=Direct; name-matches Printavo -> Customer ID, $, city. Confidence gate. Fuzzy matcher is the weakest link.

touchpoints.name: Open-Deal Guard (2)
touchpoints.trigger: on quote / while a deal is live
touchpoints.notes: The suppressor: stamps Date of Last Quote/Activity; mutes ALL retention outreach while a deal is open. Stage-set omits 5022/5013 - fix before Save-Touch goes live.

touchpoints.name: Relabel - Relationship Status
touchpoints.notes: Counts paid invoices -> advances New Prospect -> Returning -> New -> Repeat (forward-only). Node mislabeled '~6am'.

touchpoints.name: Enrich - ID Heal (3)
touchpoints.notes: Fills the join key from invoice->customer. Confidence gate; backfill + daily self-heal. Node mislabeled '2am'.

touchpoints.name: Pass 2a - Conversion Finalize
touchpoints.notes: Sets Conversion Date; finalizes Customer ID, $, geo, New-vs-Return. LIMIT=15/run. The gold-standard enricher.

touchpoints.name: Convert - Sale -> Retention (1)
touchpoints.notes: Find-or-create the Retention box (tier, dept, cadence, stage). Sets NEW/ACTIVE/REACTIVATED. 7/5 twin-prevention fix indexes linked-sale CIDs.

touchpoints.notes: Rebuilds #orders, spend, last-order-date, cadence from full Printavo history. Risks the 300s cap -> partial re-band; paginate/shard.

touchpoints.notes: Moves ACTIVE <-> AT-RISK by cadence (BAND_MULT 1.25x). Never auto-sets INACTIVE.

touchpoints.name: AT-Risk Save-Touch (4, Layer B.1)

stages.exitRule: A 2nd paid order moves them to ACTIVE; 12 months with no 2nd order moves them to LOST.

stages.name: ACTIVE
stages.entryRule: They place a 2nd paid order (graduating from NEW) or recover from a save, and are within 1x their typical cadence.
stages.exitRule: Days since last order exceed 1.25x cadence (or an event customer misses their season-opening window) -> AT RISK.

stages.name: AT RISK
stages.entryRule: The band-updater flips them when they pass 1.25x-2x their normal cadence, or miss an expected season opening.
stages.exitRule: A new paid order returns them to ACTIVE; no response after Touch 2 (or >2x cadence) moves them to INACTIVE.
stages.northStarAnchor: North Star, Lifecycle Stage - AT RISK

stages.name: INACTIVE
stages.entryRule: The band-updater moves them here after a failed AT RISK touch and days past 2x cadence.
stages.exitRule: A reorder commitment moves them to REACTIVATED; 90 days with no response, or a hard no, moves them to LOST.

stages.name: REACTIVATED
stages.entryRule: A customer who was AT RISK or INACTIVE places a new order or makes a clear commitment; the PM moves them here manually.
stages.exitRule: 90 days post-reactivation on rhythm -> ACTIVE; going cold again -> AT RISK or INACTIVE.

stages.name: LOST
stages.entryRule: 12 months from NEW with no 2nd order, or 90 days in INACTIVE with no response, or a hard no from the customer.
